title: chore(console): move the objectui pin 616df6598b42 → cf153eb2e535, past objectui's stored_expression toast row (objectui#13233), so PR #24778 can land
body:
Fixes #24928
Clause-②: no

This PR moves the console pin from `616df6598b42` to `cf153eb2e535`: objectui `main` at `cf153eb2e5351505abf3b82fb76bfdc9a841bbde`. That commit carries `8803ca54ac` (objectstack-ai/objectui#13233, objectui#13178), which adds the `stored_expression` row to objectui's `STRIPPED_LINE` in `packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts`. It is the newest objectui `main` commit at or after `8803ca54ac` whose objectui **push** `CI` run had concluded `success`, coverage lane included, when the pin moved. With it, the `domain:spec` lane's PR #24778 (#24690) can land without reddening the Console Pin Gate.

This PR is not a release act. The Version Packages PR is not touched, and no release workflow is dispatched. No objectui source changed, nothing was written to objectui, and no product code, `.github/workflows/**` or `scripts/build-console.sh` change is in it.

**Tier:** not governed. `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch claude/issue-24928-objectui-pin` at `a1c663ae62`: "0 of 4 path(s) hit the register (7 surfaces govern objectstack) ... NOT governed", exit 0. Size: 4 files, +87 / -6.

## Choosing the pin

All 31 jobs concluded `success`: `Test (coverage)` and all eight `Test (coverage shard N/8)`, the sixteen `Test (shard N/16)`, `Test`, `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Build Docs` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check`. Read off `repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/39483449911/jobs` at 2026-10-20T20:03Z.
- **The read at the move** (`actions/workflows/223145786/runs?branch=main&event=push`, 20:03:24Z, re-read 20:04:58Z, just before the bump at about 20:05Z):

The two commits it passes over are `9e1bff63a` (objectstack-ai/objectui#13283) and `53dea27af` (objectstack-ai/objectui#13284), both app-shell fixes.
- **Ancestry**, in a full (non-shallow) scratch clone of objectui (`--is-shallow-repository` false), each against `cf153eb2e535`:

- **The row is in the pin.** `git show cf153eb2e535:packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.ts`: line 145 declares `STRIPPED_LINE: Record` keyed by `DroppedFieldsEvent['reason'] | 'stored_expression'`, and line 173 holds the `stored_expression` entry.
- **objectui's own objectstack pin moved in this range:** `.objectstack-sha` `f4755a68a797` → `06cab4849a8a` (objectstack `chore: version packages (#24524)`, an ancestor of this branch's base, exit 0).

## The procedure, as written

No shared objectui checkout was written: `/home/user/objectui` is shallow and shared, so every objectui read came from the full scratch clone, which `OBJECTUI_ROOT` names. `build-console.sh` then makes its build worktree from that clone, so its worktree registration lands in the clone, not in the shared checkout. Exit codes were captured before any pipe; the heavy steps ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

With no breaking entry, the generator wrote no ADR-0087 placeholder, so no line of it is hand-written.

## Proof that the pin carries the row, against PR #24778's spec

Staging: PR #24778's head `56cac787cbe5` was fetched (`pull/24778/head`) into a scratch objectstack worktree, installed, and its seven packed packages built (`turbo run build` of the client, formula, lint, sdui-parser and types closures, 36/36, lock VERDICT 0). A second objectui worktree at `cf153eb2e535` was made from the scratch clone, and `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT=PR24778_WORKTREE node scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build` packed those packages into it ("from ... os-pr24778 (56cac787…)"), then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, exit 0. From `packages/app-shell` there, `@objectstack/spec/data` resolves to the packed copy, and `DroppedFieldsEventSchema.shape.reason.options` reads `["readonly","readonly_when","primary_key","computed","stored_expression"]`. Control: the same probe in this branch's build tree reads the four-member list.

**Command,** from the objectui worktree root: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose packages/app-shell/src/providers/writeWarningToast.test.ts`.

| leg | spec installed | result | exit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | PR #24778 `56cac787cb` (five reasons) | 20 passed, 1 failed (21) | 1 |
| B, control | this branch (four reasons) | 21 passed (21) | 0 |

- **`gives every reason the pinned spec declares its own wording (#3935)`**, the test that drives each reason: **passed** on leg A, over all five reasons the PR #24778 spec declares, `stored_expression` included. Passed on leg B too.
- **`words reason \`stored_expression\` as a computed value saved in place of the one sent, in en and zh (objectui#13178)`**: passed on both legs.
- **The one red on leg A is objectui's designed tripwire,** `reminds the pin bump that carries \`stored_expression\` to retire the widening (objectui#13178)`. It asserts the installed spec does NOT declare `stored_expression`, with the message "the spec pin now declares `stored_expression`: delete `| 'stored_expression'` from STRIPPED_LINE's key type and make spec-symbol-batch6.test.ts's `_ReasonIsTheEnum` pin the five-member union". It fires once objectui's OWN `.objectstack-sha` reaches a spec that declares the arm. It is objectui's suite, and objectstack's Console Pin Gate does not run it.

**And the console build against PR #24778's tree, at this pin.** `bash scripts/build-console.sh` run from the PR #24778 worktree with its `.objectui-sha` set to `cf153eb2e535` (a scratch edit) and `OBJECTUI_ROOT` naming the scratch clone: exit 0, lock VERDICT 0. objectui's dependency build ran 34/34, the console's `tsc && vite build` transformed 8966 modules, and `grep -c 'error TS'` over the log is 0. The injection assertion found PR #24778's own text: "present (injected only): ') written with the computed value in place of the caller'", "5 of 5 injected-only descriptions are in the bundle". So the Console Pin Gate's build holds at this pin both before and after PR #24778.

## The Console Pin Gate

- **It does not run on this PR or in the merge queue.** `ci.yml`'s `console-pin` job has `github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.event_name != 'merge_group'` in its `if:`. So the **pre-merge full battery is NOT MEASURED** on GitHub, and the local run below is the pre-merge reading. The CI proof is `main`'s first full-battery run after the merge: this PR changes `.objectui-sha`, so the console-dist cache key misses and that run builds the console fresh at `cf153eb2e535`.
- **Local run, as the job runs it,** at `a1c663ae62` (the build itself ran at `af060f0855`; the later commit changes only the two records): install (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, exit 0); the client closure (36/36); `build-console.sh` (exit 0). Deviations from the job: `--concurrency=2` for the closure and for objectui's dependency build, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096`, `OBJECTUI_ROOT` names the full scratch clone where CI shallow-clones, and there is no cache restore, so `CACHE_HIT` is empty.
  - `build-console.sh`'s `.objectstack-sha` branch ran in order: objectui's own `@objectstack/*` built at its `.objectstack-sha` `06cab4849a8a` as the reference, then "OBJECTSTACK_ROOT is set: packing @objectstack/* from /home/user/objectstack-issue-24928", 7 packages from `af060f0855`, then the frozen install ("Lockfile is up to date"), objectui's dependency build 34/34 (0 cached), and the console's `tsc && vite build` ("8966 modules transformed"). `grep -c 'error TS'`: 0.
  - Closing checks: "Bundle canary 'import/jobs' present"; "Single-zod canary: exactly one zod version literal {major:4,minor:6,patch:7}" (2261 `assets/*.js` read); "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it (vendored: @objectstack/spec of objectui's own build of objectstack 06cab4849a8a)", "2 of 2 injected-only descriptions are in the bundle"; "@objectstack/console dist ready (65684 KB) from objectui@cf153eb2e535".
  - "Assert a real Console dist is in place": `index.html`, `assets/` and the `.objectui-sha` stamp are present.
  - `pnpm check:console-sha`: "Console dist matches the objectui pin (objectui@cf153eb2e535).", exit 0.
  - `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp`: self-test 100 assertions, then "@objectstack/spec: the dist carries this tree's copy, and not the published one.", exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

Observations, not filed:

- **The target is the newest green at the move, not at the PR's opening.** At 20:05Z the two newer `main` commits' push runs were still in progress. Both concluded `success` by 20:22Z, after the bump and while the build ran. Moving to `53dea27afab5` instead is a mechanical re-bump plus a rebuild, about 25 minutes of lock. Neither commit (objectstack-ai/objectui#13283, objectstack-ai/objectui#13284) is needed for PR #24778.
- **The injection assertion's stale leg has nothing to detect at this pin.** objectui's reference spec (`06cab4849a8a`, 40 commits behind this tree's base) declares no description this tree lacks, so the pin-only pool is 0 and the stamp records `staleDetector: null`. The fresh leg found its witness (2 of 2). At `616df6598b42` both legs had witnesses (16 of 22 and 10 pin-only). This is the script's documented honest case, not a failure.
- **The tripwire on leg A above is objectui's to retire** when objectui bumps its own `.objectstack-sha` past PR #24778 (delete `| 'stored_expression'` and widen `_ReasonIsTheEnum`, per the test's own message). Nothing in this repo runs it.
- `approvals.record-page-decisions` cites `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalDecisionActions.test.tsx` in its `source`. That file is absent at both pins: objectui `99782f961` deleted it, and that commit is an ancestor of `616df6598b42` (exit 0). Carrier: the checklist anchor #24579.
